title: His first bass solo on Gerald Wilson's "Dissonance in Blues"
summary: He says the feature was written for him and a bootleg credited the wrong player.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: You were telling me also that you recorded a bass solo with Gerald Wilson that is credited on the record to somebody else. Do you want to tell me that story?

Yeah. It was "Dissonance in Blues," an original that Gerald wrote especially to feature me on the bass. I saw it lately. Some bootleggers in Europe or somewhere had copied the record, and they didn't know who the bass player was, so they just inserted some name. But for posterity and everything, that's me playing the bass solo on "Dissonance And Blues." That was my first solo attempt on a record.

Yeah, that was in the early Forties. I had done many records, but I had never been really featured. I was just, you know, a background bass player. So on this the whole side featured the bass, and I'm still proud of it.
